summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running any code or tests, and without committing. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch yields (patch, coordinates) pairs; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; PatchDataset docstring uses float), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc after GridPatchDataset), and new tests/test_grid_dataset.py (TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape, test_loading_array, plus two extra checks). Unverified: the test suite has not been run; the GridPatchDataset docstring example output was derived by reasoning. In test_loading_array, patch values are checked as a constant shift of the source region within [-1, 1], because RandShiftIntensity draws its shift randomly, so exact values are not hard-coded.
